scope: Family-level rejection of the Russian surface:ru:ka grouping. The complete stored member set and all its evidence classes are locked below; the words were not individually annotated.

decisions.reason: The transliterated surface sequence ka groups unrelated Russian stems and endings. Examples include абиссинийка (nationality), аэрофотосъёмка (recording), адвокатишка (diminutive/pejorative) and актрисочка (diminutive). The final letters -ка or -очка do not establish a shared whole-lemma etymon. Every stored link is candidate-index evidence rather than a checked lexical derivation.

review_scope: Reject the incoherent surface family as a unit while preserving corpus lemmas and any other family memberships. This does not assert that every word lacks a valid separate derivational relationship.
